title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager role based in Birmingham City Centre. This role is an exciting opportunity working for a successful marketing agency.

Client Details

My client is a marketing agency that focuses on SMEs based in Birmingham city centre looking for a Marketing Manager.

Description
- Develop and deliver integrated marketing strategies aligned with client goals and business objectives.
- Present strategic recommendations, insights, and campaign performance to clients and prospects.
- Monitor, analyse, and optimise campaign performance to maximise results and ROI.
- Support the Marketing Director while leading and mentoring Marketing Executives.

Profile
- Agency experience delivering B2 B marketing.
- Understanding of PPC and SEO
- Strong experience partnering with SMEs and owner-managed businesses.
- Commercially minded with a results-driven approach to marketing.
- Solid knowledge of the full marketing mix, with HubSpot and inbound marketing experience a distinct advantage.
- Track record of delivering measurable ROI and business growth.
- Exposure to management tolls such as Trello
- Can commute to Birmingham city centre.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary
- Opportunity to work within the varied media and agency industry.
- 4 days working in office,Friday work from home with 4pm finish
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Bonus based on results and customer retention
- Marketing Manager

title: PPC
description:
PPC Manager based in Birmingham City Centre. This role offers hybrid opportunity with 1 working from home day,

Client Details

My client is a successful marketing agency specialising in supporting SMEs based in Birmingham city centre looking for a PPC Manager.

Description
- Manage and optimise PPC campaigns across various platforms, ensuring performance aligns with client objectives.
- Conduct keyword research and create effective ad copy to maximise click-through rates and conversions.
- Monitor campaign performance, analysing data to identify trends and make data-driven decisions.
- Develop and implement A/B testing strategies to enhance campaign effectiveness.
- Provide regular performance reports and insights to clients, focusing on key metrics and ROI.
- Collaborate with internal teams to align campaigns with broader marketing strategies.
- Stay updated on PPC trends and platform updates to apply best practices.
- Manage budgets effectively and ensure campaigns deliver within allocated spend.

Profile
- Strong experience managing and optimising PPC campaigns.
- Knowledge of Adwords, Microsoft Ads, Paid social channels are largely Meta and Linkedin(not tik tok and insta).
- Excellent analytical skills and the ability to interpret data effectively.
- Knowledge of keyword research tools and techniques.
- Experience in A/B testing and campaign performance improvement.
- Strong communication skills for client reporting and collaboration with teams.
- An understanding of the media and agency industry.
- Can commute to Birmingham city centre.

Job Offer
- Negotiable salary
- Bonus based on targeted performance
- Up to 8% matched pension
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Opportunity for progression

title: Ecommerce Administrator
description:
An experienced Eccommerce Administrator is required to join a fast-expanding Fashion company. We are looking for an enthusiastic, passionate and organised individual who would relish working with a variety of brands and products including in the fashion industry. The applicant would be working directly within the E-commerce team helping to grow sales on major selling platforms like Amazon, eBay, OnBuy etc

Role
- Uploading products to selling platforms, ensuring the details are accurate and the products are presented properly.
- Problem solving catalogue issues such as trademark, compliance and image issues.
- Analysing shipping costs and category fees, to ensure we are getting the best rates possible.
- Working with the product and brand teams to ensure all products are setup ahead of their launch dates.
- Using translation tools to make sure our catalogue is duplicated across Europe.

Applicants should have:
- Knowledge and experience of working with Microsoft Excel.
- Experience working with online retailers and their administration requirements.
- Good organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and grammatical ability
- An interest in E-commerce
